V = V_rev + 3 (3 sqrt3/2) R^2 - 3 pi 2.511^2 - 16 pi 1.25^2. A: bottom annulus, chamfer cone, r = 5 cylinder, the hexagon less r = 5 at z = 5.5, six sides 3 R, the hexagon less r = 2.511 at z = 8.5, the neck, two cones, top annulus, bore. Bounds: the hexagon, its first vertex on +x (x +-R, y +-R sqrt3/2), z 0..16. 16 faces, genus 1.
